results.title: How Different Discussion Formats Shape Political Disagreement Between Citizens:
results.reason: This paper focuses on political discourse and communication formats between citizens with opposing political views, which falls under political psychology rather than clinical psychology. It examines how text-based versus face-to-face discussions affect political disagreement, hostility, and willingness to engage in political discussions. There is no focus on mental health, psychopathology, diagnosis, therapy, assessment, or clinical interventions for individuals with psychological disorders.

Smarter Together: Using the Science of Cooperation to Build Effective Global Col
results.reason: This paper focuses on research methodology and team science collaboration in psychological research, not clinical psychology practice. It discusses coordination of large research teams, social networks, and scientific collaboration processes without addressing therapy, assessment, diagnosis, psychopathology, mental health interventions, or clinical utility for practicing clinicians.

results.title: Viscereality: Empirical Validation of a Bioresponsive Virtual-Reality Breathing
results.reason: The paper examines a bioresponsive virtual reality breathing environment with potential clinical applications for breathing regulation and modulation of altered states of consciousness, which has direct relevance to mental health interventions and therapeutic practices.
results.authors: George Fejer; Till Holzapfel; Anestis Lalidis Mateo; Taru Hirvonen; Johannes Blum; Michael Gaebler; Bigna Lenggenhager

results.title: Action Control in Emotion Regulation: When Reappraisal May Carry Hidden Costs
results.reason: The study examines emotion regulation strategies (reappraisal and acceptance) in the context of clinical psychology, specifically how they affect responses to reminders of past adversity (parental divorce). This has direct implications for therapeutic practice and mental health interventions.
results.authors: David Brian Rompilla, jr.; Connor Bazar; Savannah Dod; Valerie Lu; Takashi Yamauchi
